title: GDPR Article 35 — Data Protection Impact Assessment
description: The requirement to conduct a Data Protection Impact Assessment for high-risk processing under the GDPR. Paraphrase pending verification against the primary EUR-Lex text — hence 'Community' confidence.
control_text: Controllers must carry out a Data Protection Impact Assessment before processing that is likely to result in a high risk to individuals' rights and freedoms, such as systematic and extensive automated decision-making or profiling that produces legal or similarly significant effects. Article 35 DPIA obligations are broader than just automated-decision-making — they also cover large-scale special-category data processing and large-scale public monitoring.
